blockers: Production session configuration does not yet require the registry or bind its observation callback to receipt-derived cohort metrics; a legacy arbitrary callback path remains for compatibility.
The fixed-look schedule is not automatically joined to the power-based sample-size plan or prospective performance evidence; no live result is claimed.
implemented: The policy freezes ordered session-count looks, familywise alpha, drawdown harm floor and freeze timestamps into a content hash.
Unscheduled efficacy views return no efficacy decision; alpha is divided across registered looks.
Risk harm stops at any observation, including between looks; missing risk evidence fails closed.
The module reports order permission semantics without granting permission at efficacy checkpoints.

FixedLookRegistry persists policies in a hash-chained journal and binds each policy digest to a registered ExperimentCharter revision risk-policy hash; it verifies archived revisions during recovery and rejects policy resolution after charter revision.

ForwardPaperSessionService can evaluate the registered policy from a supplied observation callback, persist harm stops to the append-only paper-account latch before strategy evaluation, include the report in the runner verdict and preserve the latch through restart.
